**Date:** {{< meta display-date >}}  
**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Miss Yonge is much obliged to [Mr Bourn](../persons.html#178) for sending her several reviews and critical notices of [Hopes & Fears](../books.html#37).

She would be glad to know how the sale of the work has been proceeding.

Miss Yonge would be much obliged if Mr Bourn would inform her whether [Mr Parker](../persons.html#1144) is pretty well, and also to express to him her sincere regrets and condolence[^1]

[^1]: His son [John William Parker](../persons.html#1143), Jr. (1820-1860) had died on 9 November.

Bourn and the elder Parker were now running the firm.
